changelog: Security Hardening: Upgraded key derivation to 600,000+ PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256 iterations (OWASP compliance) with automatic seamless legacy vault migration.
Universal Inline Entity Creation: Create new Assets during Investments, new Loans during Debt repayments, new Accounts during Transfers, and Custom Categories on the fly.
Category Icon Engine Overhaul: Replaced legacy red/green dots with categorized Lucide icon packs and introduced rich Category Designer with search and custom color pickers.
Lifelog-Grade Sync Architecture: Multi-relay fallback (ntfy.envs.net + ntfy.sh in parallel), Google STUN direct WebRTC DataChannel, and entity-level LWW state synchronization.
PWA & Android Live Update Immunity: Workbox NetworkFirst cache strategy, instant service worker updates, and Android WebView cache-trap immunity.
